entries.title: Why your cardiologist might tell you to skip AirPods
entries.summary: The magnetic fields emitted by your headphones will need to be used a safe distance away from your CIDs.
entries.excerpt: Next time you visit your grandparents, you might want to put your headphones away. Cardiologists have long warned about the risks smartphones, headphones and other consumer devices pose towards cardiovascular implantable devices (CIDs). Concerns revolve around the magnetic fields these devices emit, which can inadvertentlytrigger a magnet-safe modeon defibrillators and pacemakers that potentially prevents them from detecting tachycardia or other cardiovascular irregularities.

entries.title: Congress lets decades-old spying law lapse amid Trump's controversial DNI nomination
entries.summary: Congress, afraid of empowering Bill Pulte, has allowed a decades-old spying law to lapse.
entries.excerpt: Congress failed to extend a key surveillance law on Thursday night,according to a report byPolitico. This effectively means that Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA) will expire for the first time since 2008, as the House isn't expected to vote again until June 23.
